label: Figure 3
title: Federal indirect cost rules and the 2025 rate caps, with the status of each on October 5, 2026
caption: The table sets the standing federal rules on indirect costs beside the rate caps of 2025 and gives the position of each as the records state it. Two different things are called 15 percent. One is the de minimis rate, which an organisation with no current negotiated rate may elect, at up to 15 percent of modified total direct costs [1802](#cite:1802). The other is the cap that NIH, DOE, NSF and the Department of Defense announced in 2025 on rates already negotiated [24](#cite:24) [1852](#cite:1852) [237](#cite:237) [1855](#cite:1855). Each of the four was set aside by the District of Massachusetts, and none is in effect [24](#cite:24) [237](#cite:237) [289](#cite:289) [1855](#cite:1855). The rows between them are limits written into a statute, a regulation or a programme notice, among them 30 percent of Total Federal Funds Awarded at NIFA and NIH fellowships that pay no indirect costs [412](#cite:412) [736](#cite:736). One NIH policy text gives the de minimis rate as 10%, and both figures are kept as separate rows [64](#cite:64). Modified total direct costs has no row of its own, being the base and not a rate. Foundation limits on indirect costs are left to a separate figure.
how_to_read: Read across a row to see one rule: who it covers, the rate, what the rate is multiplied by, the text that sets it and where it stands. The first rows are standing rules. The middle rows are limits written into a statute, a regulation or a notice. The last rows are the 2025 caps, the appropriations provisions around them and two changes still pending. Compare the base before you compare two rates: 30 percent of total federal funds and 15 percent of modified total direct costs are not measured on the same thing. "Not stated" means the record gives no base or no date. A blank in the number column means no single figure applies.

explain.text: An indirect cost rate is a percentage applied to a base of direct costs [1849](#cite:1849) [1850](#cite:1850). The usual base, modified total direct costs, counts salaries and wages, fringe benefits, materials and supplies, services, travel and up to the first $50,000 of each subaward, and leaves out equipment, tuition remission and participant support costs, among other items [1799](#cite:1799).

The Uniform Guidance and the HHS Grants Policy Statement give the rate as 15 percent, and HRSA records that HHS raised it from 10 to 15 percent effective October 1, 2024 [1802](#cite:1802) [528](#cite:528) [529](#cite:529). The NIH policy text as fetched gave 10% [64](#cite:64).

These are the words of the court orders as the records report them. For the NSF cap the court vacated the policy, declared it invalid and did not issue a permanent injunction [1854](#cite:1854). For the Department of Defense cap it vacated the policy and made the earlier injunction permanent [1855](#cite:1855).

NSF states that from May 19, 2025 it issues awards at the institution's negotiated rate, and that awards issued on or after May 5, 2025 carry a term applying NSF 25-034 if NSF is later permitted to apply it [154](#cite:154).

Public Law 119-103 continues the fiscal year 2026 appropriations acts, with their conditions on indirect cost rates, through December 11, 2026 [1480](#cite:1480). The same law bars a final rule revising the Uniform Guidance through that date [1480](#cite:1480).

source: Values are taken from the mechanics and changes records of the Token for Granted content pack and from the numbered references beside each fact, as published on the pages read on October 4–5, 2026. Wording and figures are as the records give them. The rate_num column restates a published rate as a plain percent number; awards that pay no indirect costs are entered as 0, and rows with no single rate are left blank.

rows.applies_to: Organisations that receive federal awards directly and have negotiated a rate with their cognizant agency
rows.rate_or_limit: the rate, or rates, in the organisation's negotiated agreement; no single figure
rows.set_by: 2 CFR 200.414(c)(1); Appendix III (institutions of higher education) and Appendix IV (non-profits) to 2 CFR part 200
rows.status: In force. The eCFR text current to October 1, 2026, read October 4, 2026, requires all federal agencies to accept negotiated rates, with two exceptions.

rows.rule: Limit on administrative costs inside a university's rate
rows.applies_to: Institutions of higher education: the administrative categories of the facilities and administrative rate
rows.rate_or_limit: 26% of modified total direct costs
rows.set_by: Appendix III to 2 CFR part 200, section C.8
rows.status: Standing rule in the record, read in the annual edition of the Code of Federal Regulations revised as of January 1, 2025.

rows.applies_to: Recipients and subrecipients without a current federal negotiated rate, which includes many small non-profits
rows.rate_or_limit: up to 15 percent of modified total direct costs; no documentation needed; may be used indefinitely
rows.announced_or_effective: awards executed on or after October 1, 2024, as NSF states it
rows.status: In force. The eCFR text current to October 1, 2026 carries the rate; NEH, IMLS, IES, HHS and USDA state 15 percent. One NIH text gives 10% (next row).

rows.rule: De minimis rate as the NIH Grants Policy Statement text gives it
rows.applies_to: NIH applicants with no federally negotiated rate
rows.rate_or_limit: 10% of modified total direct costs, in the fetched policy text
rows.set_by: NIH Grants Policy Statement, section 7.4
rows.status: Disagrees with the row above. 2 CFR 200.414(f) and the HHS Grants Policy Statement give 15 percent; HRSA records a rise from 10 effective October 1, 2024.

rows.applies_to: Foreign and international organisations on NIH and other HHS grants
rows.rate_or_limit: 8 percent
rows.base: modified total direct costs, as the NIH policy statement gives it
rows.set_by: 2 CFR 300.414(b); NIH Grants Policy Statement, section 7.4
rows.status: In the HHS regulation as read on eCFR, current to October 1, 2026.

rows.applies_to: Training grants from HHS agencies; the HHS Grants Policy Statement includes career awards
rows.rate_or_limit: 8% of modified total direct costs
rows.status: In the HHS regulation as read on eCFR, current to October 1, 2026. It governs in place of the de minimis rate.

rows.rule: NIH training, career and research education awards
rows.applies_to: K awards, K12 programmes, T32 and T35 training grants and R25 research education grants
rows.rate_or_limit: 8% of modified total direct costs, not the organization's negotiated rate
rows.base: modified total direct costs; on training grants, exclusive of tuition and fees, consortium costs in excess of $25,000 and equipment
rows.set_by: NIH parent notices PA-24-176 (K01), PA-27-030 (K12), PA-25-168 (T32) and PA-27-036 (R25)
rows.status: As stated in the notices read. The R00 phase of the K99/R00 uses the institution's own rate.

rows.rule: HRSA primary care research training grant (NRSA)
rows.applies_to: HRSA's FY 2026 primary care National Research Service Award
rows.rate_or_limit: 8% of modified total direct costs, whatever the institution's negotiated rate
rows.set_by: Notice of Funding Opportunity HRSA-26-035
rows.status: As stated in the FY 2026 notice.

rows.applies_to: NIFA competitive awards; stated in the FY 2026 AFRI and Specialty Crop notices; sub-awardee indirect costs count
rows.rate_or_limit: the lesser of the negotiated rate or 30 percent of Total Federal Funds Awarded
rows.set_by: section 1462 of NARETPA (7 U.S.C. 3310)
rows.announced_or_effective: standing rule; stated in FY 2026 notices
rows.status: Statutory limit as the FY 2026 notices state it. NIFA's indirect costs page tells applicants to follow the limitation in each notice.

rows.rule: NIH individual fellowships and conference grants
rows.applies_to: NIH individual fellowships and NIH conference grants
rows.rate_or_limit: none
rows.set_by: NIH Grants Policy Statement, section 7.4; parent F31 notice PA-25-422
rows.status: As stated in the policy text and the notice read.

rows.rule: NIH S10 instrument awards and C06 construction awards
rows.applies_to: S10 Shared Instrumentation and Seed Instrumentation Support awards; C06 research facility awards
rows.rate_or_limit: none: S10 awards do not allow indirect costs; the C06 notice lists F&A costs as unallowable
rows.set_by: NIH notices PAR-27-022 and PAR-27-021 (S10) and PAR-26-106 (C06)
rows.status: As stated in the notices read.

rows.rule: Department of Defense DURIP equipment awards
rows.applies_to: DURIP awards, as the record reads the FY27 announcement
rows.rate_or_limit: equipment costs are treated as exempt from indirect costs
rows.set_by: FY27 DURIP NOFO N0001426SF003
rows.status: As the record states it from the FY27 announcement.

rows.rule: NIFA AFRI predoctoral and postdoctoral fellowships
rows.applies_to: AFRI Education and Workforce Development predoctoral and postdoctoral fellowships
rows.rate_or_limit: none: indirect costs are not permitted; a $3,000 per year institutional allowance is paid to the institution in their place
rows.set_by: FY 2026 AFRI Education and Workforce Development Notice of Funding Opportunity
rows.status: As stated in the FY 2026 notice.

rows.applies_to: National Needs Graduate and Postgraduate Fellowship grants to institutions
rows.rate_or_limit: none: indirect costs are not authorised; an institutional allowance is paid per fellow
rows.set_by: FY 2026 National Needs Graduate and Postgraduate Fellowship Grants Program Notice of Funding Opportunity
rows.status: As stated in the FY 2026 notice.

rows.applies_to: The Knauss Marine Policy Fellowship and any costs associated with it
rows.rate_or_limit: none: indirect costs are not allowable
rows.set_by: FY 2027 Knauss Marine Policy Fellowship notice NOAA-OAR-SG-2027-32433
rows.status: As stated in the FY 2027 notice.

rows.applies_to: NHPRC grant recipients, as the documentary editions announcement states
rows.rate_or_limit: none: grant funds may not be used for indirect costs
rows.set_by: 2 CFR 2600.101, as the NHPRC announcement EDITIONS-202505 indicates
rows.status: As stated in the FY 2026 announcement, which is closed.

rows.applies_to: REU Site proposals and Supplement requests: the budget category that holds student stipends, housing and travel
rows.rate_or_limit: no indirect costs may be recovered on participant support costs
rows.set_by: NSF 23-601 program solicitation
rows.status: As stated in the solicitation read.

rows.applies_to: All NIH grants, as the notice states, in place of negotiated rates
rows.rate_or_limit: 15 percent, in place of a negotiated rate
rows.set_by: NIH notice NOT-OD-25-068, Supplemental Guidance to the 2024 NIH Grants Policy Statement
rows.status: Vacated. District of Massachusetts enjoined it March 5, 2025, later permanently, and vacated the notice; First Circuit affirmed January 5, 2026. An association reports no Supreme Court petition was filed.

rows.applies_to: DOE grant awards to institutions of higher education
rows.rate_or_limit: a standardized 15 percent indirect cost rate
rows.set_by: DOE Policy Flash 2025-22
rows.status: Vacated. District of Massachusetts enjoined it May 15, 2025, vacated it June 30, 2025. DOE: no longer in effect from January 23, 2026. Association timeline: appeal dismissed March 16, 2026.

rows.applies_to: DOE awards to state and local governments, non-profits and for-profit organisations; indirect and fringe benefit reimbursement
rows.rate_or_limit: figure not given in the record
rows.announced_or_effective: 2025; dates not given in the record
rows.status: Withdrawn. DOE Policy Flash 2026-30 of January 27, 2026 states they are no longer in effect from January 23, 2026, citing Section 313 of H.R. 6938.

rows.rule: ARPA-E notice clause limiting indirect costs
rows.applies_to: Open ARPA-E programme notices; the example in the record is the CATALCHEM-E notice, DE-FOA-0003505
rows.rate_or_limit: indirect cost cap at 15% of Total Project Costs
rows.set_by: the Maximum Limit on Indirect Costs clause of the ARPA-E notices
rows.status: Removed from open notices by modification; in the CATALCHEM-E notice by Modification 03 of February 6, 2026.

rows.applies_to: New NSF awards to institutions of higher education issued on or after May 5, 2025; not retroactive
rows.rate_or_limit: a rate no greater than 15% of modified total direct costs
rows.set_by: Policy Notice NSF 25-034
rows.status: Vacated and declared invalid June 20, 2025, District of Massachusetts. A case summary records NSF's appeal dismissed on its own motion September 30, 2025. Not in effect.

rows.applies_to: New and existing Department of Defense assistance awards to institutions of higher education
rows.rate_or_limit: indirect cost rates capped at 15%
rows.set_by: memorandum from the Secretary of Defense and memorandum from the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering
rows.status: Vacated and enjoined. District of Massachusetts enjoined it July 18, 2025; vacated it and made the injunction permanent October 10, 2025. Plaintiff association: Government's appeal dismissed February 18, 2026.

rows.rule: Appropriations provisions that keep negotiated rates
rows.applies_to: NIH (section 224); DOE (section 313); NASA, Commerce and NSF (section 542, from a consultant's note; statutory text not reached)
rows.rate_or_limit: no rate set: the indirect cost rules, including approval of deviations from negotiated rates, apply as in an earlier year (NIH: third quarter of fiscal year 2017; DOE: fiscal year 2024)
rows.set_by: Public Law 119-75, section 224; H.R. 6938, sections 313 and 542; continued by Public Law 119-103
rows.status: In force through December 11, 2026: Public Law 119-103 continues the fiscal year 2026 acts with their conditions. What follows depends on the fiscal year 2027 acts.

rows.rule: Proposed revision of the Uniform Guidance on facilities and administrative costs
rows.applies_to: Discretionary grants, as Executive Order 14332 defines them
rows.rate_or_limit: no figure: the order directs OMB to limit the use of discretionary grant funds for facilities and administrative costs
rows.set_by: Executive Order 14332, section 5; OMB proposed rule, 91 FR 32198
rows.status: Proposed; no revision has taken effect. An association summary says the proposal leaves negotiated rates unchanged. Public Law 119-103, section 157, bars a final rule through December 11, 2026.

rows.rule: NIH fiscal year 2027 budget request: cap on F&A costs
rows.applies_to: Each NIH award, under the request
rows.rate_or_limit: 15 percent of the applicable direct cost base for each award
rows.set_by: FY 2027 President's Budget (NIH congressional justification)
rows.status: A budget request, marked proposed in the ledger. Section 224 of the FY 2026 appropriations act keeps the indirect cost provisions of 45 CFR part 75 applying to NIH grants.
